The reference code uses trial_type which is the instructed direction (left/right), not the actual behavioral choice. So the AI's use of trial_instruction is consistent with the reference code. However, calling it 'lick direction choice' when it's actually the instructed direction (which determines correct vs incorrect) is semantically imprecise. On trials where the mouse licks the wrong direction (miss), the 'choice' here represents the instruction, not the actual lick direction. This is the same convention used in the reference code (trial_type = instructed direction), so it matches the reference.

The percentiles are computed over all valid tongue y-values across all trials in the session, which is correct per the task spec ('per-session discretization').
